newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech crown firms after cen bank comments.
newsitem.headline: Czech crown firms after cen bank comments.

text.p: 0857 GMT - The Czech crown firmed on Monday morning after the Czech National Bank (CNB) said it was not discussing any imminent cut in interest rates, that the weakening of the crown seen early on Monday was not justified by fundamentals, and that it would support the currency if necessary.

* Crown/dollar 31.098, crown/mark 17.899 implying a deviation from the mid-point of the crown's mark/dollar basket of -2.92 percent compared with around -3.8 percent before the central bank's remarks.
* "The market of course reacted (to the CNB's comments)... When the crown was at -3.50-3.80 we were waiting to see whether the CNB would do something," said one local currency dealer.
"The fixing will be watched more closely today than usually" he added.
* The CNB fixes the crown every day at 0930 GMT.
